review:
Floating Dragon Megaways Hold&Spin reimagines the 2021 hit on a 6x6 Megaways layout with up to 236,196 ways to win. The familiar Chinese New Year symbols return, but the extra reel height makes base-game wins look quite different from the 10-line original.

There are two bonuses. In free spins, collect symbols gather instant wins, and every four collectors retrigger the round and raise the overall multiplier. The Hold&Spin round awards three respins that reset whenever a new instant-win prize lands. Both features feed into the 20,000x maximum, among the highest in the Floating Dragon family. The 96.7% RTP is also a strong point. Expect higher variance than the original version.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
